title: Selecting Healthy Tomato Plants for Gardening
reason: The video provides detailed guidance on selecting and transplanting tomato plants in Wyoming gardens.

tasks.task: Provide guidance on selecting tomato plants for Wyoming gardens.

subtasks.text: Observe that the tomato plant is a mainstay in Wyoming gardens.
Note the importance of selecting a plant with overall health.
Watch for any broken branches or signs of disease.

tasks.task: Explain the proper method for transplanting tomato plants.

subtasks.text: Observe the process of gently removing the tomato plant from its pot.
Note the practice of plucking the bottom branches before planting.
Describe the technique of planting the plant deeper than in the pot.

tasks.task: Discuss the characteristics of tomato plants that are preferred by many.

subtasks.text: Observe the preference for plants with blossoms and tomatoes.
Highlight the consideration of transplanting stress in larger plants.
Mention the significance of a big red tomato.
